versions.changelog: Rewrote frontmatter description to concise 200–500 character format for improved agent-trigger clarity.

Initial release. Five-phase workflow covering engagement scoping, process decomposition, risk identification with inherent likelihood × impact rating, key-control mapping with control attributes (P/D, M/A, frequency, owner, evidence), and Test of Design + Test of Operating Effectiveness plan generation, producing a DRAFT Risk-Control Matrix with Top-10 risks, control-gap list, and audit-program outline for licensed internal auditor and CAE review.
